latest_message:
Dear Benico,

Thank you for reaching out. I want to clarify the $200 value mentioned in your gifts package.

The $200 represents the combined value of all the perks you receive (your interview results, personalized Master Prompt pack, and AI Interview Prep Kit), not a direct cash payout. It reflects the worth of these resources to help you improve and understand your performance.

You should now be able to see and access all of these in your dashboard. If anything is not visible, please let me know.

Let us know if you have any questions,

Best regards,

--
Jessica from Flowmingo Customer Support Team
Mobile / WhatsApp (Support Hotline): (+84) 989 877 953
